paperTitleZh: 全新模擬卷 — 試卷一

parts.questionTextZh: 把 $\dfrac{5+t}{2t-1}=m$ 的主項變換為 $t$ 。
parts.questionTextEn: Make $t$ the subject of the formula $\dfrac{5+t}{2t-1}=m$ .
Simplify $\dfrac{(a^{-3}b^{2})^{-2}}{a^{4}b^{-5}}$ and express your answer with positive indices.

parts.label: a
parts.questionTextEn: Factorize $3x^{2}+5xy-2y^{2}$ .

parts.label: b
parts.questionTextEn: Factorize $3x^{2}+5xy-2y^{2}-6x+2y$ .

parts.questionTextZh: 某工場製造甲、乙兩款木椅。製造每張甲款木椅需時 $45$ 分鐘，而製造每張乙款木椅需時 $30$ 分鐘。某星期該工場共製造 $260$ 張木椅，所用時間合共 $150$ 小時。求該星期製造甲款木椅的數目。
parts.questionTextEn: A workshop makes two models of wooden chairs, A and B. It takes $45$ minutes to make each chair of model A and $30$ minutes to make each chair of model B. In a certain week, the workshop made $260$ chairs in total, using $150$ hours altogether. Find the number of chairs of model A made in that week.

parts.label: a
parts.questionTextZh: 求同時滿足 $\dfrac{2x-1}{3}\ge x-4$ 及 $18-5x<43$ 的 $x$ 的取值範圍。
parts.questionTextEn: Find the range of values of $x$ which satisfy both $\dfrac{2x-1}{3}\ge x-4$ and $18-5x<43$ .

parts.label: b
parts.questionTextZh: 有多少個整數滿足 (a) 中的兩個不等式？
parts.questionTextEn: How many integers satisfy both inequalities in (a)?

parts.label: a
parts.questionTextZh: 點 $P$ 的坐標為 $(5,2)$ 。把 $P$ 對直線 $y=x$ 反射，得 $P'$ ；再把 $P'$ 向左平移 $10$ 單位，得 $P''$ 。寫出 $P'$ 及 $P''$ 的坐標。
parts.questionTextEn: The coordinates of the point $P$ are $(5,2)$ . $P$ is reflected with respect to the straight line $y=x$ to $P'$ . $P'$ is then translated leftwards by $10$ units to $P''$ . Write down the coordinates of $P'$ and $P''$ .

parts.label: b
parts.questionTextZh: 設 $O$ 為原點。求 $\triangle OPP''$ 的面積。
parts.questionTextEn: Let $O$ be the origin. Find the area of $\triangle OPP''$ .

parts.label: a
parts.questionTextZh: 棒形圖顯示某班學生上月借閱圖書數目的分佈，其中代表借閱 $1$ 本的棒被墨水弄污了。若從該班隨機選出一名學生，該學生上月借閱最少 $3$ 本圖書的概率為 $\dfrac{11}{40}$ 。求上月借閱 $1$ 本圖書的學生人數。
parts.questionTextEn: The bar chart shows the distribution of the numbers of books borrowed by the students of a class last month, where the bar representing $1$ book is covered by ink. If a student is randomly selected from the class, the probability that the student borrowed at least $3$ books last month is $\dfrac{11}{40}$ . Find the number of students who borrowed $1$ book last month.

parts.label: b
parts.questionTextZh: 求該分佈的中位數及眾數。
parts.questionTextEn: Find the median and the mode of the distribution.

parts.label: a
parts.questionTextZh: 某印刷公司印製一批小冊子的成本 $\$C$ 部分是常數，部分隨印製數量 $n$ 正變。印製 $200$ 本的成本為 $\$3\,400$ ，而印製 $500$ 本的成本為 $\$7\,000$ 。以 $n$ 表示 $C$ 。
parts.questionTextEn: The cost $\$C$ of printing a batch of booklets by a printing company is partly constant and partly varies directly as the number of booklets $n$ printed. The cost of printing $200$ booklets is $\$3\,400$ and the cost of printing $500$ booklets is $\$7\,000$ . Express $C$ in terms of $n$ .

parts.label: b
parts.questionTextZh: 若印製數量由 $500$ 本增加 $40\%$ ，求成本的百分增加，答案準確至三位有效數字。
parts.questionTextEn: If the number of booklets printed is increased by $40\%$ from $500$ , find the percentage increase in the cost, correct to 3 significant figures.

parts.label: a
parts.questionTextZh: 某條絲帶的長度以最接近的 $0.1$ m 量度為 $2.4$ m。求該絲帶長度的最小可能值。
parts.questionTextEn: The length of a ribbon is measured as $2.4$ m correct to the nearest $0.1$ m. Find the least possible length of the ribbon.

parts.label: b
parts.questionTextZh: 有 $30$ 條這樣的絲帶，每條的長度均以最接近的 $0.1$ m 量度為 $2.4$ m。店員宣稱把這 $30$ 條絲帶的總長度以最接近的 $1$ m 量度時，結果可以是 $74$ m。該宣稱是否正確？試解釋你的答案。
parts.questionTextEn: There are $30$ such ribbons, each measured as $2.4$ m correct to the nearest $0.1$ m. A shop assistant claims that when the total length of the $30$ ribbons is measured correct to the nearest $1$ m, the result can be $74$ m. Is the claim correct? Explain your answer.

questions.categoryZh: 圓的性質與全等三角形

parts.label: a
parts.questionTextZh: 圖中，$A$ 、 $B$ 、 $C$ 及 $D$ 位於以 $O$ 為圓心的圓上，其中 $AB\parallel DC$ 。$AC$ 與 $BD$ 相交。證明 $\triangle ADC\cong\triangle BCD$ 。
parts.questionTextEn: In the figure, $A$ , $B$ , $C$ and $D$ lie on the circle with centre $O$ , where $AB\parallel DC$ . $AC$ and $BD$ intersect. Prove that $\triangle ADC\cong\triangle BCD$ .

parts.label: b
parts.questionTextZh: 已知圓的半徑為 $5$ cm 及 $\angle ACD=35^{\circ}$ 。求扇形 $OBC$ 的面積，以 $\pi$ 表示答案。
parts.questionTextEn: It is given that the radius of the circle is $5$ cm and $\angle ACD=35^{\circ}$ . Find the area of the sector $OBC$ in terms of $\pi$ .

parts.label: a
parts.questionTextZh:
下面的莖葉圖顯示 $10$ 名學生某日做運動的時間（以分鐘計）的分佈，其中 $a$ 及 $b$ 為整數。
莖（十位） | 葉（個位）
$1\mid 6\quad 9$
$2\mid 3\quad 5\quad a$
$3\mid 1\quad b\quad 8$
$4\mid 2\quad 7$
已知該分佈的中位數為 $29.5$ 分鐘，而眾數為 $31$ 分鐘。求 $a$ 及 $b$ ，並求該分佈的平均值及標準差（標準差答案準確至三位有效數字）。
parts.questionTextEn:
The stem-and-leaf diagram below shows the distribution of the times (in minutes) spent on exercise by $10$ students on a certain day, where $a$ and $b$ are integers.
Stem (tens) | Leaf (units)
$1\mid 6\quad 9$
$2\mid 3\quad 5\quad a$
$3\mid 1\quad b\quad 8$
$4\mid 2\quad 7$
It is given that the median and the mode of the distribution are $29.5$ minutes and $31$ minutes respectively. Find $a$ and $b$ , and find the mean and the standard deviation of the distribution (give the standard deviation correct to 3 significant figures).

parts.label: b
parts.questionTextZh: 後來加入另一名學生的數據，其做運動的時間為 $30$ 分鐘。該分佈的標準差會增加還是減少？試解釋你的答案。
parts.questionTextEn: Later, the datum of another student, whose time spent on exercise is $30$ minutes, is added. Will the standard deviation of the distribution increase or decrease? Explain your answer.

parts.label: a
parts.questionTextZh: 把一個半徑為 $6$ cm 的實心金屬球熔掉，再鑄成一個實心模型。該模型由一個實心半球及一個實心直立圓錐組成，兩者的底重合，且半徑均為 $6$ cm。假設熔鑄過程中沒有損失金屬。求該圓錐的高。
parts.questionTextEn: A solid metal sphere of radius $6$ cm is melted and recast into a solid model. The model consists of a solid hemisphere and a solid right circular cone, whose bases coincide and both have radius $6$ cm. Assume that there is no loss of metal. Find the height of the cone.

parts.label: b
parts.questionTextZh: 求該模型的總表面面積，答案準確至三位有效數字。
parts.questionTextEn: Find the total surface area of the model, correct to 3 significant figures.

parts.label: a
parts.questionTextZh: 圓 $C$ 的圓心為 $K(-2,3)$ ，且 $C$ 通過點 $A(4,11)$ 。求 $C$ 的方程。
parts.questionTextEn: The centre of the circle $C$ is $K(-2,3)$ and $C$ passes through the point $A(4,11)$ . Find the equation of $C$ .

parts.label: b
parts.questionTextZh: 求 $C$ 在 $A$ 的切線的方程。
parts.questionTextEn: Find the equation of the tangent to $C$ at $A$ .

parts.label: c(i)
parts.questionTextZh: (b) 中的切線與 $x$ 軸及 $y$ 軸分別相交於 $P$ 及 $Q$ 。寫出 $P$ 及 $Q$ 的坐標。
parts.questionTextEn: The tangent in (b) cuts the $x$-axis and the $y$-axis at $P$ and $Q$ respectively. Write down the coordinates of $P$ and $Q$ .

parts.label: c(ii)
parts.questionTextZh: 設 $O$ 為原點。由此，求 $\triangle OPQ$ 的外接圓的方程。
parts.questionTextEn: Let $O$ be the origin. Hence, find the equation of the circumcircle of $\triangle OPQ$ .

parts.label: a
parts.questionTextZh: 設 $f(x)=3x^{3}+px^{2}+qx-8$ ，其中 $p$ 及 $q$ 為常數。已知 $f(x)$ 可被 $x-2$ 整除。當 $f(x)$ 除以 $x+1$ 時，餘數為 $3$ 。求 $p$ 及 $q$ 。
parts.questionTextEn: Let $f(x)=3x^{3}+px^{2}+qx-8$ , where $p$ and $q$ are constants. It is given that $f(x)$ is divisible by $x-2$ . When $f(x)$ is divided by $x+1$ , the remainder is $3$ . Find $p$ and $q$ .

parts.label: b(i)
parts.questionTextZh: 把 $f(x)$ 因式分解。
parts.questionTextEn: Factorize $f(x)$ .

parts.label: b(ii)
parts.questionTextZh: 有人聲稱方程 $f(x^{2})=0$ 有四個實根。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
parts.questionTextEn: Someone claims that the equation $f(x^{2})=0$ has four real roots. Do you agree? Explain your answer.

questions.categoryZh: 標準分與四分位數間距

parts.label: a
parts.questionTextZh: 下表顯示某班 $20$ 名學生在一次小測中的分數分佈。求分數為 $8$ 分的學生的標準分，答案準確至三位有效數字。
parts.questionTextEn: The table shows the distribution of the scores of $20$ students of a class in a quiz. Find the standard score of a student who scored $8$ marks, correct to 3 significant figures.

parts.label: b
parts.questionTextZh: 後來有兩名學生補考，分數分別為 $4$ 分及 $9$ 分。班主任聲稱把這兩個分數加入後，分佈的四分位數間距不變。此說法是否正確？試解釋你的答案。
parts.questionTextEn: Later, two students sat a make-up quiz and scored $4$ marks and $9$ marks respectively. The class teacher claims that after including these two scores, the inter-quartile range of the distribution remains unchanged. Is the claim correct? Explain your answer.

questions.categoryEn: Probability with Combinations and Conditional Probability

parts.label: a
parts.questionTextZh: 盒中有 $6$ 個紅球及 $4$ 個白球。若同時從盒中隨機抽出 $4$ 個球，求最少抽得 $3$ 個紅球的概率。
parts.questionTextEn: A box contains $6$ red balls and $4$ white balls. If $4$ balls are drawn randomly from the box at the same time, find the probability that at least $3$ red balls are drawn.

parts.label: b
parts.questionTextZh: 已知抽出的 $4$ 個球中最少有 $3$ 個紅球，求 $4$ 個球全是紅球的概率。
parts.questionTextEn: Given that at least $3$ of the $4$ balls drawn are red, find the probability that all the $4$ balls are red.

parts.label: a
parts.questionTextZh: 設 $f(x)=60x-3x^{2}$ 。求 $y=f(x)$ 的圖像的頂點的坐標。
parts.questionTextEn: Let $f(x)=60x-3x^{2}$ . Find the coordinates of the vertex of the graph of $y=f(x)$ .

parts.label: b(i)
parts.questionTextZh: 嘉欣沿一道直牆用長 $30$ m 的圍欄圍成一個梯形花圃 $ABCD$ ，其中 $AB$ 為牆的一部分，$AB\parallel DC$ ，$AD=BC=x$ m，且 $\angle DAB=\angle CBA=60^{\circ}$ （見圖）。圍欄只用於 $AD$ 、 $DC$ 及 $CB$ 。以 $x$ 表示花圃的面積。
parts.questionTextEn: Ka-yan uses a fence of length $30$ m to enclose a trapezoidal flower bed $ABCD$ along a straight wall, where $AB$ is part of the wall, $AB\parallel DC$ , $AD=BC=x$ m and $\angle DAB=\angle CBA=60^{\circ}$ (see the figure). The fence is used for $AD$ , $DC$ and $CB$ only. Express the area of the flower bed in terms of $x$ .

parts.label: b(ii)
parts.questionTextZh: 嘉欣相信花圃的面積可大於 $130$ m$^{2}$ 。嘉欣是否正確？試解釋你的答案。
parts.questionTextEn: Ka-yan believes that the area of the flower bed can be greater than $130$ m$^{2}$ . Is Ka-yan correct? Explain your answer.

parts.label: a(i)
parts.questionTextZh: 圖中所示的帳篷的形狀為一個三角柱 $ABCDEF$ ，其長方形底 $BCDE$ 位於水平地面上，兩個三角形端面 $ABC$ 及 $FED$ 均鉛垂於地面，且 $AF\parallel BE\parallel CD$ 。已知 $AB=1.5$ m、 $BC=2.4$ m、 $CA=2.1$ m 及 $BE=3$ m。求 $\angle ABC$ 。
parts.questionTextEn: The tent in the figure is in the shape of a triangular prism $ABCDEF$ . Its rectangular base $BCDE$ lies on the horizontal ground, the two triangular end faces $ABC$ and $FED$ are vertical, and $AF\parallel BE\parallel CD$ . It is given that $AB=1.5$ m, $BC=2.4$ m, $CA=2.1$ m and $BE=3$ m. Find $\angle ABC$ .

parts.label: a(ii)
parts.questionTextZh: 求 $A$ 離地面的高度。
parts.questionTextEn: Find the height of $A$ above the ground.

parts.label: b(i)
parts.questionTextZh: 求 $BF$ 的長度及 $\angle FBC$ 。
parts.questionTextEn: Find the length of $BF$ and $\angle FBC$ .

parts.label: b(ii)
parts.questionTextZh: 露營者聲稱平面 $FBC$ 與地面之間的交角大於 $23^{\circ}$ 。此說法是否成立？試解釋你的答案。
parts.questionTextEn: A camper claims that the angle between the plane $FBC$ and the ground is greater than $23^{\circ}$ . Does this claim hold? Explain your answer.

parts.label: a(i)
parts.questionTextZh: 某病人按甲方案每天早上服藥一次，每次服用 $200$ mg。經過一天後，體內的藥量會減少 $r\%$ 。設 $T_{n}$ mg 為第 $n$ 次服藥後即時的體內藥量，其中 $T_{1}=200$ 。已知 $T_{2}=320$ 。求 $r$ 。
parts.questionTextEn: A patient takes a drug once every morning under Plan A, with $200$ mg each time. After one day, the amount of the drug in the body decreases by $r\%$ . Let $T_{n}$ mg be the amount of the drug in the body immediately after the $n$th dose, where $T_{1}=200$ . It is given that $T_{2}=320$ . Find $r$ .

parts.label: b(i)
parts.questionTextZh: 以 $n$ 表示第 $(n+1)$ 次服藥前即時的體內藥量。
parts.questionTextEn: Express, in terms of $n$ , the amount of the drug in the body immediately before the $(n+1)$th dose.

parts.label: b(ii)
parts.questionTextZh: 由此，求 $n$ 的最小值使得第 $(n+1)$ 次服藥前即時的體內藥量多於 $299$ mg。
parts.questionTextEn: Hence, find the least value of $n$ such that the amount of the drug in the body immediately before the $(n+1)$th dose exceeds $299$ mg.

parts.label: c
parts.questionTextZh: 醫生考慮改用乙方案：每兩天早上服藥一次，每次服用 $315$ mg，而每經過一天，體內的藥量仍會減少 $40\%$ 。醫生宣稱長遠而言，按乙方案每次服藥後即時的體內藥量會高於按甲方案的。試解釋該宣稱是否正確。
parts.questionTextEn: The doctor considers switching to Plan B: the drug is taken once every two days in the morning, with $315$ mg each time, and the amount of the drug in the body still decreases by $40\%$ after each day. The doctor claims that in the long run, the amount of the drug in the body immediately after each dose under Plan B will be higher than that under Plan A. Explain whether the claim is correct.
